scope_note: Re-issue of the V-FINAL adversarial double-answer audit on the POST-ÄGARDOM shipping bytes of candidates-final/las-b17-003.json. The prior issue of this file (2026-08-26) was written against pre-repair bytes and is preserved in git history at cfbb963. Prime directive of this pass was to REFUTE the claim that Q2 is now uniquely solvable. I could not. Three of the four prior findings survive because they sit in parts the ägardom deliberately did not touch; they are re-issued below rather than carried as resolved.

findings.claim: The G-SPRÅK major on shipping PASSAGE text — objectless "Det är svårt att komma runt." — has escalated from 1-of-3 in round 1 to 3-of-3 unanimous on the fresh ägardom legs, and my own adjudication now lands against the prior audit's overrule: the flag is about the OBJECTLESS use, which is not what the prior audit defended.
findings.evidence: Passage p4: "Bråtemo tycker att jag läser in för mycket. Ett häfte är en önskan, säger han, och ingen vet vad läraren faktiskt sade när dörren var stängd. Det är svårt att komma runt." Fresh verdicts-agardom/verdicts-gsprak.jsonl runs 1, 2 and 3 all flag it major and all propose the same native form: "Det är svårt att komma ifrån." Run 1: "'komma runt' är transitivt i svenskan och kräver objekt ('komma runt problemet/invändningen'). Objektslöst i den koncessiva positionen är det den fasta svenska vändningen 'komma ifrån' som gäller." Run 3: "Utan objekt kalkerar frasen 'That is hard to get around.'" Round-1 record (verdicts.jsonl) had two G-SPRÅK passes and one flag on the same sentence. The prior audit overruled on the ground that "Swedish does have komma runt in the kringgå sense (komma runt reglerna)" — but that defends the TRANSITIVE use, and all three fresh legs locate the defect precisely in the missing object, which the prior audit itself conceded was "the only English-leaning part". ADJUDICATION.md line 1083 offered the owner the exact fix as a menu item (`ändra las-b17-003: komma runt → komma ifrån`); the ÄGARDOM of 2026-08-30 selected only the Q2/D rewrite and expressly preserved the passage, so the sentence ships unremediated by design, not by oversight.
findings.why: I verified independently that this has ZERO impact on uniqueness or answerability, in either question. The sentence carries the narrator's concession, which is the SECOND pillar of D's refutation; the first pillar — Bråtemos "ingen vet vad läraren faktiskt sade när dörren var stängd" — kills new D on its own, and the following "Men …" would signal a preceding concession even to a reader who misparses the verb. So this is a language-quality defect on shipped prose, not a ship-blocker, and it does not overturn the CONFIRMED verdict. OWNER NOTE: the evidence base changed materially since the owner last saw this item (1/3 → 3/3, and the specific ground shifted from lexical availability to object ellipsis), so the deferral is worth re-taking rather than assumed to stand. Cost of the fix is now two coordinated one-word edits, not one — see the finding below.

findings.claim: CARRIED, UNRESOLVED. The Q1 rationale still asserts a contradiction the passage does not contain: publisher provenance and publisher production do not exclude teacher authorship, so "Texten motsäger det ändå två gånger" is an invalid inference presented as fact in the teaching payload.
findings.evidence: Q1 rationale, byte-identical to the pre-repair commit (verified: questions[0] compares equal to HEAD:candidates-final/las-b17-003.json in full): "D är plausible_worldknowledge … Texten motsäger det ändå två gånger: häftena kommer från de två förlag som dominerade marknaden, och i stycke 4 slås det fast att samma förlag gjorde både bild och häfte." Passage p2: "alla från de två förlag som dominerade marknaden." Passage p4: "Bild och häfte är förstås inte oberoende av varandra, eftersom samma förlag gjorde båda." Neither sentence is about authorship; "gjorde" is not "skrev", and a publisher commissioning teacher-authors is exactly the real-world plausibility the trap trades on. The sentence that actually disfavours Q1/D remains unused by the rationale: p1 "den talade om för läraren vad som skulle göras med bilden" casts the teacher as ADDRESSEE, and p2's single marginal note in eighty-three booklets — a date — shows near-zero teacher inscription.
findings.why: Re-verified on current bytes rather than carried on trust. The key C is untouched and survives (Q1/D additionally fails the stem's "utmärkte … historieserierna" requirement, since nothing in the text distinguishes history-series authorship from nature-series authorship), so this is not a key defect. It remains a one-clause repair in the teaching payload. Unchanged severity from the prior issue.

findings.claim: CARRIED, UNRESOLVED. The Q1 rationale's claim that no option reproduces the passage's wording is false on its face — the key's distinguishing lexeme "påståenden" is the passage's own word — and the same clause additionally carries a collocation slip that a fresh G-SPRÅK leg flags independently.
findings.evidence: Q1 rationale (unchanged): "Ordvalet är utbytt (besked → påståenden, dominerade redan i de tidigaste årgångarna → fulla av påståenden från början), så inget alternativ återger textens formulering." Passage p5 contains the corpus's only occurrence of the stem: "Det innehåller elva påståenden, en ordlista och en enda fråga." (verified: exactly one match for /påstående/ in the passage). Key Q1/C: "De var fulla av påståenden från början." The claimed substitution is not away from the text but toward a word the text uses. G-SPRÅK run 1 flags the same clause on separate grounds: "Man byter ut ord, inte ett 'ordval'; 'ordvalet' är ett resultat, inte ett utbytbart objekt. Native alternative: 'Orden är utbytta (…)'."
findings.why: Kept at minor for the same reason as the prior issue, re-checked rather than assumed: the lexical echo sits in p5 (the 1958 mjölkhantering booklet), not in the p3 historieserie sentence the item is keyed to, so a word-matcher scanning for "påståenden" lands in the wrong paragraph and is not handed the key. The Q1 key still requires the besked → påståenden synonym mapping to be earned from p3. Factual-claim defect in a rationale, which is the integrated stage's own criterion; no key impact.

Verified absent from the pre-repair rationale (substring "handledningen talade enligt stycke 1 om för läraren" occurs in the current Q2 rationale, in neither the HEAD Q2 rationale nor the Q1 rationale), so the clause is new in this round. findings.why: Recorded because the brief's summary that the rewritten D drew ZERO G-SPRÅK findings is true of the OPTION TEXT only — the rewritten RATIONALE did draw two. It is grammatical, it is a fronting-order fix of the sort the legs themselves supply, and it has no effect on correctness or on which option is defensible, so it is minor, not a blocker. Worth surfacing because a repair round that introduces a fresh flag in the artefact it was sent to fix is exactly the class of drift this audit exists to catch.

findings.claim: Register mixing in the rationales — an open corpus-wide question that this unit exemplifies rather than causes.
findings.evidence: Q1 rationale: "hedgningen ”troligen”" (English stem + Swedish -ning, not in SAOL; the Swedish term is "gardering") and "över tid" where the same unit uses the native "med tiden" in three options. Q2 rationale (unchanged A paragraph): "Sista stycket ger samma sak i ett enda konkret fall" — thin verb, "visar" expected. Both rationales carry untranslated taxonomy labels (scope_shift, reversed_causality, plausible_worldknowledge, detail_as_main, half_right_conjunction). G-SPRÅK run 1 states the policy question directly: "konvention i korpusen, men om rationalen visas för eleven är hela registerblandningen värd ett beslut."
findings.why: Filed as info, not as a defect of las-b17-003: the taxonomy labels are house convention across every batch, and the two lexical items are register wobbles with no correctness impact. It belongs in a corpus-level decision about whether rationales are student-facing, not in this unit's ledger.

Additional hostile pass: A and D both fail the stem's "utmärkte … historieserierna" requirement; only C is both supported and genre-specific.

A "Planschen blev med tiden mer ett stöd för lärarens besked än ett underlag för frågor": two converging strands, the booklet trend in p3 ("frågorna blivit färre och de färdiga beskeden fler"; "sjunker andelen frågor från ungefär två tredjedelar till knappt en tredjedel") and the chart trend in p4 ("de sena planscherna har färre småting i utkanterna, mindre att peka på som inte redan är förklarat"), with p5's 1958 booklet as the concrete case. CLEAN — no defensible reading found under maximum hostility. New D's load-bearing clause asserts that the booklets show how the charts were ACTUALLY used. Passage p4 denies exactly that, on the same lexeme: "ingen vet vad läraren faktiskt sade när dörren var stängd" against D's "hur planscherna faktiskt användes". I then swept every paragraph for a rescue. p1 "De följde med planschen till klassrummet och blev liggande i katederlådan" places the booklet in the room but says nothing about it recording events, and "blev liggande" if anything implies neglect. p2's single marginal date is one booklet in eighty-three and its content — a date — says nothing about HOW anything was used; the passage frames it as an absence. p3 measures the booklets' own contents, i.e. the script, not the performance. p5 inventories one booklet post by post, again the artefact. No paragraph supports D.

CLEAN — the turn does not rescue D. p4's recovery is "Just därför säger de något, nämligen att förändringen var avsiktlig." Avsiktlig is a claim about the producers' INTENT, which sits on the önskan/borde side of the ought-is divide that D tries to cross; it is not a claim about classroom practice. The premise the turn rests on — "Bild och häfte är förstås inte oberoende av varandra, eftersom samma förlag gjorde båda" — is explicitly a PRODUCTION fact, which makes the recovered conclusion production-side by construction. The independent G-DISTRACTOR counsel case for D dies on this same point, and I reach it independently.

CLEAN — no partial-credit reading. "X, inte bara Y" asserts X and merely declines to limit the situation to Y; it presupposes Y rather than asserting it. So D's truth value is determined entirely by "Häftena visar hur planscherna faktiskt användes i klassrummen", which is denied. A student who reads only the trailing clause is reading a presupposition the passage does grant (p1: the booklet told the teacher what to do), but that reading leaves the sentence's main assertion false. There is no reading on which D is true, and the stem is a superlative ("överensstämmer bäst"), so even a hypothetical partial support would still rank behind A.

Two independent fresh G-KEY legs solved A cold and neither raised over-reading; the asymmetry the repair_log claims between A and new D holds up under attack.

CLEAN — two fresh minors examined and overruled rather than carried. (1) Run 2's intrasentential tense mix "Där dominerade beskeden … och andelen frågor förblir liten hela vägen": the passage applies a consistent division — preterite for the historical situation ("såg det annorlunda ut", "dominerade", "fanns") and descriptive present for corpus measurement ("ligger stilla", "sjunker", "förblir", "går det att räkna") — so the shift inside the sentence is principled, marking the move from a historical statement to a corpus statement. Neither is a defect.
